_tieu_de: Do dropdown 'Security Mode' o trang Wi-Fi > General -- ca hai kien truc: GOP bang tan (Primary/Guest khi chua tach) va TACH rieng tung bang (SmartHome)
_vi_sao: GD5/GD6 (2026-08-14) da ghi trong ISSUES.md: o Select nay chua tung
duoc noi __noiOChon()/__moMenuChon() vi KHONG co bang chung markup
danh sach chon (chi biet nhan hien tai qua text, khong biet cau truc
cua tung muc trong danh sach khi mo). Phien nay do truc tiep bang
Chrome dieu khien vao thiet bi that de lay du bang chung, KHONG doi
gi tren thiet bi (chi mo dropdown de doc DOM/CSSOM, khong bam chon
gia tri khac vi se lam gian doan Wi-Fi that dang dung).

che_do_GOP._ghi_chu: Do o tab PRIMARY NETWORK ('2.4GHz, 5GHz' gop lam mot). Gia tri dang chon luc do: WPA3-Personal-Transition.

o_dong_luc_chua_bam__mui_component_selec._luu_y: CHI co bang chung cho gia tri WPA3-Personal-Transition. Chua doi duoc sang WPA2-Personal/WPA23T tren thiet bi that (se lam gian doan Wi-Fi that) nen KHONG co bang chung o-dong cho 2 gia tri con lai.

danh_sach_mo__li_trong_ul.MuiMenu-list.co_chip: Default (span.MuiChip-label.css-9iedg7 trong div.MuiChip-root.css-o8x9y1, boc trong div.MuiStack-root.css-1r9kwv0)

danh_sach_mo__li_trong_ul.MuiMenu-list._luu_y: 4 doan p rieng biet (khac 2 doan cua hai muc kia). Da do dung 4 chuoi that, nhung CHUA doi chieu duoc class css- rieng cua doan p thu 3/4 (suy theo mau lap lai v6shwc/u79te2 cua muc 1, chua xac nhan rieng).

che_do_TACH._ghi_chu: Do o tab SMARTHOME NETWORK, dai 2.4GHz (o duy nhat dang BAT trong 2 dai cua tab nay -- 5GHz dang tat nen KHONG mo duoc dropdown de do, Guest Network cung dang tat toan bo nen khong do duoc). Gia tri dang chon luc do: WPA3-Personal-Transition.
che_do_TACH.diem_dac_biet: O day O DONG va MUC TRONG DANH SACH hien CUNG MOT chuoi van ban tho, khong co Stack/Chip/nhieu doan nhu che do gop -- da xac nhan qua do that, KHONG phai suy doan.

danh_sach_va_o_dong._luu_y: Hien NGUYEN VAN gia tri enum, khong dich sang ten than thien -- la hanh vi THAT cua thiet bi (khac han muc WPA3T ben duoi), khong phai loi.

_gap_chua_do_duoc: Dai 5GHz khi TACH rieng (SmartHome 5GHz dang tat, Guest 5GHz/2.4GHz cung tat) -- chua ro danh sach tuy chon co giong het 2.4GHz hay khac (vd co them tuy chon WPA3-only cho 5GHz).
Guest Network khi duoc BAT va o che do TACH (hien Guest dang o che do GOP, giong Primary) -- chua co bang chung rieng.

_ket_luan_cho_bo_gia_lap: 1. Da noi day du danh sach MO cho ca 2 kien truc (gop: 3 tuy chon; tach 2.4G: 2 tuy chon).

2. O DONG cua che do gop: dung dung bang chung that cho gia tri WPA3-Personal-Transition; 2 gia tri con lai CHUA co bang chung o-dong rieng, tam ghep lai tu cac doan cua muc trong danh sach (KHONG doi chieu pixel, ghi ro trong code va ISSUES.md).
3. O DONG cua che do tach 2.4G: dung CHINH XAC boi vi da xac nhan no giong het chu cua muc trong danh sach.
4. KHONG noi Select cho dai 5GHz/6GHz khi tach rieng, va KHONG noi cho Guest khi (neu sau nay) chuyen sang tach rieng -- thieu bang chung, giu nguyen hanh vi cu (khong bam mo duoc) thay vi doan.

5. Cac lop CSS that (css-x3whsd, css-r8u8y9, css-o8x9y1, css-u79te2) duoc dung CHUNG cho MOI popup Select tu dung trong toan thiet bi (khong rieng Wi-Fi) vi window.__moMenuChon() gan cung ten lop cho moi noi goi -- thay the quy tac TAM (mau MUI mac dinh 25,118,210) bang mau thuong hieu that (47,84,235).
